text: Deutsche Telekom's own shareholder-structure page shows the Federal Republic of Germany as the anchor shareholder via KfW (approx. 14.4%) plus a direct federal holding, together roughly 28-30% of shares, with the balance free float.
short: Deutsche Telekom's own shareholder-structure page shows the Federal Republic of Germany as the anchor shareholder via KfW (approx.

source.name: Deutsche Telekom Investor Relations, Shareholder structure; KfW newsroom
source.quote: Direct holdings Federal Republic of Germany; for total holdings take reference to voting right announcement (PDF, 185 KB) dated June 05th 2024.

additionalSources.name: AK&M, "German government sells stake in Deutsche Telekom for 2.5 billion euros"
additionalSources.quote: As a result of the placement, the combined stake of KfW and the German Government will be reduced to 27.8%.
